* SECURITY UPDATE: Out-of-tree file creation on reverse-applied deletion
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-115207.patch: in intuit_diff_type(),
       src/pch.c, reject an unsafe (absolute or ../) file name before
       offering to reverse-apply a patch that deletes a missing file, so
       patch no longer creates files outside the working directory
     - CVE-2026-115207
